rendered.subject: Collaboration Opportunity for an Instagram Post
rendered.body:
Hi Pela team,

We are a small Instagram content studio dedicated to bringing positive change to the world through storytelling. We’d like to propose a collaborative Instagram post built around your mission of educating and inspiring the global community of people who are committed to making a positive impact on your planet [P6]. You've highlighted that Pela's impact program has simplified operations and enabled a significant scaling of the ambassador program, which is a key part of your strategy for continued growth and engagement. To help you and your community stay on track, we envision a post that showcases your impact and invites your audience to share their own stories of positive change. It would be a chance to highlight your mission and inspire others with your work.

We'd love to hear your thoughts on this idea and if you're open to exploring a potential collaboration.

The BrandPilot team
